dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-colored rings with jagged, high-contrast outer perimeters against the dark dorsal coat; gradients show sharp transitions from dark exterior to light, mottled interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, dark, irregular core blobs nested within larger light-colored annuli; occasional isolated high-intensity light-colored clusters on the posterior lateral surface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Geometric arrangement of primary annuli centroids forms an elongated, irregular lattice along the dorsal-lateral axis, including a distinct isosceles-like triangle in the mid-torso region.
